title: Thematic resonance map artefact
description: Motif recurrence per beat/scene with the thematic statement the motifs serve. Used by paradigms that foreground thematic coherence (literary fiction outlines, motif-driven screenplay structure).

thematicStatement.description: One-sentence statement of the story's theme, in declarative form (e.g., 'Inheritance is a choice, not a duty').

recurrences.description: Each recurrence places the motif at a specific beat or scene and names what the motif means at that point.

beatRef.description: Reference to a beatId or scene number.

appearance.description: How the motif manifests at this point (literal object, line of dialogue, image, action).

meaning.description: What the motif means at this point in the story.
